rule: Free rewards are not in Nebraska's unclaimed property act, so Rewards are not reported. Thrift+ credit from refunds unused for 3 years is reported to the State Treasurer as a credit memo. Optional: one call to the Treasurer's Unclaimed Property Division to confirm.
